comment: Do not recommend. She makes the class entirely more difficult than it should be. Tons of homework and small assignments that will bring down your grade. Does not teach the material well in class and expects you to teach yourself. Makes you feel uncomfortable in class. Only allows you to speak in Spanish, even when asking questions or before class.

Not a fan. She seemed to be very biased to those who could speak Spanish very well. She also was demeaning when you answered her questions and asked. I felt uncomfortable to speak up. She brings down your grade with participation and petty assignments. I spoke up a lot and got a 85 on participation which is ridiculous. Do not recommend her at SMU.

Not at all what I was looking for in a professor. Its her way or the highway. She uses what should be boosters like homework and participation grades to bring your grade down and maintain her reputation as a demanding professor. I finished with a B+ and got a 99%, 97%, and 94% on our three exams, but an 80% in participation which is ridiculous

I hate spanish. I came in with a background lower than the prerequisite. The class is pretty demanding as it's 7 times a week. But as long as you complete homework and try to participate, you will do well. She can be a bit intimidating when she cold calls on the class. But over all I think she was a good choice as a professor.

I love Bogard's 221 class. While you must show up to every class every day of the week plus drill, if you pay attention and do your homework, you can easily get an A or A-. Bogard has so much fun teaching and makes LAIS so easy to understand. Plenty of variety with assignments: quizzes, tests, orals and papers to balance out a bad a grade or two.

I hate spanish. I've taken six years of spanish on-and-off since 7th grade, and Dr. Bogard is easily the best spanish professor I've ever had. Despite my obvious disdain for her class, she was ALWAYS there for me & kicked my butt into gear if I started to slack and lose hope in passing. Incredibly kind, helpful, and lively. Can't thank her enough.

Prof Bogard is the best for 221. Definitely take her if you can!! She's new, fun, and everyone in my class loved her. Spanish was my least favorite class all of high school and I got an A in her class! (great GPA booster since 221 is 2 credits)

I honestly can't say enough about Prof Bogard. I already liked Spanish but she made me love it. You can tell she loves the subject and is always happy to be teaching it. A couple quizzes in the semester that are short and easy, and the midterm was take home. Take this class!! I wish she taught more higher-level spanish courses.

Great Spanish professor. Took her after not taking Spanish for two years and she is very peppy and makes sure class is entertaining. I would take her again if I could. She is very helpful and grades fairly easy on tests.
